lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced vertical columns of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, with roughly 4-6 spots per vertical sequence.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular blobs, forming a macro-grid where blobs are centered within the vertical band segments.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features running horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a high-luminance edge on the dorsal side and a localized shadow on the ventral side.
